title: Jellyfish Pool Party
description: A vibrant cartoon scene of a large smiling woman in a floral swimsuit dancing in a glowing yellow pool with a smaller man wearing goggles and holding a drink. They are surrounded by purple jellyfish, musical notes, and string lights at night, with Squidward playing a clarinet in the background saying "Fine... one dance."
